test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the following two statements carefully and choose the correct option:**
Statement 1:** Adolescents constitute nearly one-fifth of India's total population.**
Statement 2:** Adolescents are grouped in the age bracket of 10 to 19 years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 2 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1** suggests that **adolescents** make up nearly **one-fifth** of the **total population** of **India**. According to the **Census of India 2011**, the **adolescent population** (individuals aged **10-19 years**) was recorded at approximately **253 million**, which accounts for about **20.9%** of the **country's** total **population**. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• **Statement 2** defines the **age bracket** for **adolescents** as **10 to 19 years**. This specific **age group** is the standard definition provided by the **World Health Organization (WHO)** and is strictly followed by the **Government of India** for **demographic** analysis and **policy formulation**. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• **Adolescents** are considered the most significant **human resource** for the **future** of the **nation**. They are in a **transitional phase** from **childhood** to **adulthood**, which is marked by rapid **physical**, **mental**, and **emotional** changes.
 
• The **nutritional requirements** of **adolescents** are significantly higher than those of a **child** or an **adult**. Poor **nutrition** during this **period** can lead to **deficiency diseases** and stunted **growth**, which is why **government programs** focus heavily on this **demographic**.
 
• In **India**, the **adolescent population** is characterized by a large **number** of individuals who require **special attention** regarding **education**, **health**, and **vocational training** to harness the **demographic dividend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Youth Policy (NYP-2014)**: While **adolescents** are aged **10-19 years**, the **National Youth Policy 2014** defines **youth** as persons in the **age group** of **15 to 29 years**. This helps in **categorizing** different **stages** of **development** for **targeted interventions**.
 
• **Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK)**: This **health program** was launched in **January 2014** by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**. It aims to reach out to **253 million** **adolescents** in **India**, focusing on **nutrition**, **reproductive health**, **substance abuse**, and **mental health**.
 
• **Anemia among Adolescents**: A critical **health issue** in **India** is the high **prevalence** of **Anemia**, particularly among **adolescent girls**. The **Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS)** program is a **government initiative** designed to address this **nutritional deficiency**.
 
• **Demographic Dividend**: **India** currently possesses a **youthful demographic profile**. The **adolescent** and **youth population** provides a **window of opportunity** for **economic growth**, provided there is adequate **investment** in their **skill development** and **health**.
 
• **Education and Literacy**: The **literacy rate** among **adolescents** has seen a **steady increase** over the **decades**, but **challenges** like **school dropouts** at the **secondary level** remain a **concern** for **policymakers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gender Concerns**: **Adolescent girls** often face **social barriers** such as **early marriage** and **restricted mobility**, which can impact their **educational** and **health outcomes** compared to **adolescent boys**.
 
• **Urban vs Rural Distribution**: A significant **portion** of **India's adolescents** resides in **rural areas**, where **access** to **quality healthcare** and **modern education** facilities is often **limited** compared to **urban centers**.
 
• **Right to Education (RTE)**: The **Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002** inserted **Article 21-A** to provide **free and compulsory education** to all **children** in the **age group** of **six to fourteen years**, which covers the **early adolescent** years.
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**: **Empowering adolescents** is crucial for achieving **SDG 3** (Good Health and Well-being), **SDG 4** (Quality Education), and **SDG 5** (Gender Equality) by the **year 2030**.
